title: Night-shift staff refused at about one sign-in in three, app and browser alike
scenario: After a Sunday maintenance window one of two on-site federation servers presents a self-signed certificate; a third of attempts, those the balancer sends to it, are refused. Staff succeed a minute later. The fix is a proper certificate and a time out of the balancer.

events.title: Call: night shift cannot sign in, about a third of attempts
events.text: Call 05:40 UTC. Ceri Llewellyn, service desk at Brynmawr Health Partnership, reports that roughly a third of sign-in attempts by night-shift staff are refused, in the Teams app and also in a browser. The same person can be refused and then accepted a minute later. About 45 staff so far. They sign in through two on-site STS servers behind a balancer, and a maintenance window on Sunday evening touched the certificates on those servers.

events.title: Re: call about night-shift sign-ins
events.text:
Hello Ceri, since your sign-in goes through your own STS pair and only some attempts fail, please inspect each of the two servers: the certificates they present (issuer, thumbprint, dates), the clocks, and the federation service event log since Sunday evening. Please also send three staff members it affected with a UTC minute each, the wording on screen, and which wards or buildings are untouched.

Arvid

events.title: STS report
events.text:
Dewi (infrastructure). Report:
sts1  service certificate CN=sts.brynmawr.example.com, issuer Brynmawr Issuing CA, valid to 2027-04-01 | clock +0.02 s | event log quiet
sts2  service certificate CN=sts.brynmawr.example.com, issuer = sts2 (self-signed), valid from 2026-06-07 | clock +0.03 s | event log: 'The remote certificate is invalid according to the validation procedure' x380 since Sunday 22:00
Staff hit: g.price 03:12 UTC, n.hughes 03:40, r.davies 04:55. No ward is better or worse, it is whoever lands on sts2.

events.title: Entra check
events.text: Entra, 03:12 / 03:40 / 04:55 UTC +/- 5 min for g.price, n.hughes, r.davies: failure rows for all three (a federated sign-in that failed); a success a minute later for each, consistent with landing on sts1 the second time.

events.title: Cause and fix
events.text:
Ceri, Dewi - cause: sts2 got a self-signed certificate during Sunday's maintenance, so every sign-in that the balancer sends to it is refused while those on sts1 go through. Fix: install the proper certificate (same chain as sts1) on sts2, and keep sts2 out of the balancer until that is done. I will check back with you at 08:00 UTC.

Arvid

events.title: sts2 repaired
events.text:
sts2 out of the balancer 06:50 UTC. Proper certificate imported 07:20, back in at 07:35. Twenty test sign-ins from staff phones and PCs since: all fine.

Dewi

events.title: Next-day check
events.text:
Re-ran the certificate and clock check on both servers: same issuer chain and thumbprint, offsets under 50 ms. Entra shows no federated failures since 07:35 UTC. Closing once the day shift has logged in without trouble.

Arvid

events.title: Re: Next-day check
events.text:
Day shift all in, thank you.

Ceri
